title: Operation-backend attachment adapter

input.requestedOutcome: Route legacy attachment usage to operation-backend in ops mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload, view and delete use /v1/attachments with Bearer transport in ops mode.
allowedScope: allotment_v2 attachment adapter and directly related view markup
constraints: Do not push or create a PR.
assumptions: Existing attachment callers retain their legacy-shaped metadata.

output.summary: Added an authenticated attachment transport/view adapter and loaded it after the ops adapters.

filesChanged.purpose: Route attachment fetches and hydrate protected views.
Use protected view URLs in PFM cards.
Use protected view URLs in booking documents.

behaviorChanges.before: Legacy /api/attach transport and unauthenticated URLs were used.
behaviorChanges.after: Fetch calls use authenticated /v1/attachments; views are hydrated from authenticated blobs.

details: Uses existing operation-backend attachment endpoints only.

verification.evidence: All changed JavaScript files parsed successfully.

decisions: Intercept only /api/attach while laOps is enabled; /api/mailimg is untouched.
Use object URLs because image/link elements cannot add the Bearer header.
risks: A browser end-to-end check remains useful for dynamically inserted PDF/canvas viewers.
dependencies: Existing laOpsFetch token transport and operation-backend attachment endpoint.
rollback: Remove the adapter script and file; legacy callers remain intact.
